verdict.rationale: Device-posture checks in authentication policy are a fair axis for an identity provider like Okta. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers checking whether a device is managed, encrypted or screen-locked before granting an app session. The pack covers only SSO, SCIM, event hooks, the MCP server and Cross App Access, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a security engineer, only healthy devices get in — device posture (managed, encrypted, screen-locked) is checked in the auth policy before an app session is granted
